content:
carla_support: FYI customer opened a ticket — they tried to stream the /v1/rerank endpoint and got a 415. Posting the minimal repro and server response they pasted.

carla_support: Customer curl they used:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-ndjson' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"input": "...", "candidates": ["a","b","c"], "stream": true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```

carla_support: Server returned:
```
HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "Unsupported Content-Type: application/x-ndjson" }
```

carla_support: Customer says SDK set `stream: true` by mistake and now is blocked, also worried about billing because they saw an extra small charge after retrying.

tom_engineer: Thanks — confirm: rerank does NOT support streaming responses. Streaming is only for generation/chat endpoints. The 415 is expected if they set a streaming Content-Type, but error message is too vague. Can we get exact headers + full body they sent?

carla_support: Pasted the full request body (sanitized key):
```json
{"input":"Find the best match","candidates":["A","B","C"],"stream":true}
```
and headers: `Content-Type: application/x-ndjson`, `Accept: text/event-stream`. They were using our generic client wrapper that sets `stream:true` flag.

dave_oncall: Urgent — customer is on a tight integration timeline. Short-term workaround: tell them to remove `stream:true`, set `Content-Type: application/json`, POST a single JSON payload to /v1/rerank. That should return the ranked scores synchronously. I'll patch a canned message.

tom_engineer: Agreed. Also we should change two things: (1) server should return a clearer 4xx body for this case: "error": "Rerank endpoints do not support streaming. Remove stream=true and use application/json." with a help link. (2) SDK client should validate and throw local error if user attempts to enable streaming for rerank. I'll create quick PRs.

alejandra_support: I can send the workaround to the customer now. Also suggest we audit other non-streamable endpoints to ensure consistent validation. Customer reported the extra charge after a retry loop — can billing confirm if a failed 415 increments usage metrics?

infra-bot: New ticket created: INF-2042 - "Improve content-type error for non-streamable endpoints". Assigned to tom_engineer.

tom_engineer: Quick repro script (node) to reproduce locally for QA: 
```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <KEY>', 'Content-Type': 'application/x-ndjson', 'Accept': 'text/event-stream' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'x', candidates: ['a','b'], stream: true })
}).then(r => r.text()).then(console.log)
```
Expect 415 + current vague body. I'll push a server change to return explicit message + docs link and add SDK validation. ETA: patch in next 48h, docs PR same day.

carla_support: Thanks — I'll update customer with the workaround and let them know we have a ticket and ETA. Will follow up when patch lands. :thumbsup:
